Manifest.Name: Neon Undertow: Vanilla Overhaul
Manifest.Author: Neon Undertow
Manifest.Description: Neon Undertow adds characters, food, drinks and animal breeding. Six wanted sheets with 54 visitors; 20 soda flavours; inherited rat coats, bodies and milk lines; fish patterns and native-tank breeding. Unfinished tool and workshop expansion excluded. Craft medicine, narcotics and biochemical supplies with the native chemistry equipment. This update adds counter trades, changes the shop economy, and saves new items and mixtures. Mishandling a dry Yardglass batch can end your run.
